chunks: Are they waiting for its exposition? The day that its exposition comes, those who had lost sight of it will say: 'The apostles of our Lord had indeed brought the truth. Do we have any intercessors to intercede for us, or that we could be returned [to the world] to act differently from what we used to act?' Indeed they have caused themselves harm, and the lies they concocted did not help.
ai.seo_question: What will disbelievers say on the Day of Judgment when the Quran's meanings are fully revealed?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the transition from the hidden meanings (ta'wil) of the Quran to their manifest reality on Judgment Day, serving as a warning to those who neglected the truth. The disbelievers' desperate plea for intercessors (shafa'ah) or a return to worldly life underscores the finality of divine decree, where their fabricated excuses and false gods prove useless. This moment encapsulates the ultimate loss (khusran) of the self, as the reality of the messengers' message becomes undeniable.
